P13_the_enumeration.the_fused_kernel_hazard_from_the_freeze: D11 named it: the fused gate+up+activation kernels (`bf16_grouped_gate_up_silu`, `q4k_ffn_gate_up*`, `q6k_geglu_*`) bake the activation into the projection dispatch. They are unreachable from a SiTU plan because the dense lowering's combine is chosen by `ffn_activation` from the POLICY and the routed paths match exhaustively on `MoeGateRule` — a new arm there is a compile error, which is how all three routed sites were found. No SiTU plan reaches a fused arm.

deviations.what: `hidden_act`'s carriage-rule `site` string still reads `ExecutionSurface.ffn.activation → FfnOp.activation`, and under a SiTU policy the fact actually lands on `ffn.gate_policy`. K3's finding #44 therefore names a field the layer does not read.
deviations.why_not_fixed_here: `CarriageRule.site` is a `&'static str`, one per rule, so making it truthful for both destinations means changing the string for EVERY row declaring `hidden_act` — 101 of 117. That is a real plan-plane movement across the estate, and the freeze pre-registered that only K3 moves. Fixing it after measuring, to make the output read better, is the reinterpretation this programme refuses.
deviations.the_honest_shape: name both destinations, as the Falcon `activation` rule already does (`ExecutionSurface.ffn.{ffn_type, activation} → FfnOp — the shape the word names`). Owed as its own transition with its own forecast, since its blast radius is 101 rows of finding text.
deviations.impact: cosmetic and confined to one string in one finding's detail. No verdict, class, category, carriage or count depends on it.

deviations.what: A control reads exactly 0.0: `up_cap_omitted` on the `no_linear_cap` oracle arm.
deviations.why_it_is_admissible: that arm HAS no up cap to omit, so the mutation is structurally inert there — and the SAME control reads 0.938 on the `k3` arm, which proves it could have read otherwise. `every_control_could_have_failed_this_test` enforces exactly that rule rather than waiving the zero: a control reading zero on every arm would fail the test.
deviations.impact: none; recorded because a control at 0.0 is normally a blind instrument and the distinction has to be stated, not assumed.

deviations.what: The oracle originally shipped EIGHT controls per arm; it ships seven. `tanh_omitted` was removed before any Rust was written.
deviations.why: dropping the tanh from `beta*tanh(g/beta)` leaves `beta*(g/beta) = g`, which IS `gate_cap_omitted` — the same perturbation reached by a second route, not a second control. Both read identical deltas on every arm. A redundant control inflates the count without adding discrimination.
deviations.what_replaced_it: the identity is kept as the ORACLE'S OWN self-check: on the arm with no up cap, `gate_cap_omitted` must equal `swiglu` to within 1e-6, which is two independently-coded mutation paths agreeing. It runs at export time, before any Rust is consulted.

deviations.why: so the out-of-crate Metal parity test dispatches the bound kernel with the SAME geometry production uses. A test computing its own threadgroup size would be checking a dispatch this crate never issues.
deviations.impact: one generic helper's visibility; no behaviour.

deviations.what: `require_plain_gate` renamed to `require_executable_gate` and narrowed to refuse ClampedGlu only.
deviations.why: the old name states a property (`is the policy plain`) that stopped being the question the function asks. It now asks whether the backend can execute the combine — `SituGlu` passes because those backends compute it, `ClampedGlu` still refuses by name with its parameters. Keeping the old name would have made it lie.

deviations.what_was_checked_first: Whether the new code is actually untested. It is not: `llvm-cov report --json` gives the SiTU dispatch arm execution count 8 and the admission guard 21-25, and no line this rung added appears in `--show-missing-lines`.
deviations.the_cause: The file's line accounting is not per-source-line. 15 of its 107 `missed` lines are lines covered in one instantiation and missed in another — 92 unique missing line numbers against 107 missed — up from 2 at the baseline. Adding 16 lines to a function counted that way moved `covered` by 3. `feedback_coverage_measurement_artifacts`.
deviations.what_was_tried_before_recording_it: Two rounds of real witnesses: first the two-arm routed test, then a third arm driving `moe_layer_forward_descriptor` on the hypothesis that its staged entry point compiled a second, unexercised copy of the core. The third arm is a genuine improvement and is kept; it moved the number not at all, which is what identified the cause as accounting rather than reach.
deviations.why_recorded_rather_than_chased: The file was ALREADY explicit debt at 80 with a note saying what it needs is `a fixture that drives a full routed layer end to end`, not more unit tests, and warning against `papering over them by asserting on encode-side state that a wrong kernel would also produce`. The uncovered lines are the same MXFP4 fused gate/up and fused down+combine arms as before this rung. The new baseline is recorded in `crates/larql-compute-metal/coverage-policy.json` with the measurement, both arms' numbers, and the machine they were taken on.
deviations.what_would_clear_it: The MXFP4 end-to-end routed fixture the original note asks for — unchanged by this rung, and still the thing that would move the number honestly.

a_defect_this_rung_introduced_and_the_su.what: `ModelArchitecture::gate_up_is_gelu_tanh` first answered from the DECLARATION rather than from `activation()`.
a_defect_this_rung_introduced_and_the_su.the_specimen: `Starcoder2Arch` OVERRIDES `activation()` to tanh-GELU and declares no `hidden_act` at all. Reading the config alone gave `Absent` -> SiLU, silently replacing a family's own judgment with the fallback — the same shape of defect this rung exists to remove, one level up.
a_defect_this_rung_introduced_and_the_su.how_it_surfaced: `exact_non_gated_starcoder2_matches_dense_with_biases`, a walk-vs-dense parity test that had nothing to do with SiTU. Not by design, and worth recording as such.
a_defect_this_rung_introduced_and_the_su.the_fix: the DECLARATION decides whether to refuse; `activation()` supplies the answer. Pinned by `a_family_override_decides_the_gate_up_kernel`, which asserts the fixture declares nothing before asserting the override wins — so it cannot pass for the wrong reason.
a_defect_this_rung_introduced_and_the_su.the_residue: a family that overrides `activation()` while its checkpoint declares an unjudged name now refuses. No in-tree architecture is in that state, refusing is the safe direction, and the plan already grades that leaf `mismatched`. Documented at the method.

two_gates_that_fired_as_designed: `config/model.rs::model_config_persists_every_forward_affecting_field` — every new `ModelConfig` field must have a home in the VINDEX3 container, or a checkpoint declaring it is served without it. Its own message names why this is invisible to CPU-vs-Metal parity: both arms read the same `index.json`. Both softcaps now round-trip in both directions (`config/model.rs` and `weights/load/arch.rs`), with the round-trip test extended rather than a new one added.

`the_semantics_version_is_pinned_to_known_verdicts` — failed until the version was bumped AND a version-20 verdict pair was recorded: a `situ` estate with both softcaps is admissible, and a `relu2` estate still blocks. The second arm is what keeps the first from having been implemented as `resolve every unknown name to itself`.
a_new_key_needs_three_registrations_not_: Worth recording for the next config-field rung, because two of the three fail SILENTLY into a passing-looking state. `CONSUMED_LEAF_KEYS` (larql-models `inventory/config_keys.rs`) or the key reads unconsumed and the carriage rule is never consulted; `EXECUTION_SEMANTIC_KEYS` (vindex `plan/semantics.rs`) or the class is `Unknown`, which short-circuits before the carriage rule so the probe never runs and the leaf reports unrepresented with a rule sitting right there; `CLUSTER_KEYS` for the cluster map. Both misses were found by the plan-plane witnesses reading `Unrepresented` where the rule claimed `Lowered`.
